ruling.recommended_action: Send the file to a Ryde human reviewer with the fact summary below; hold all automated fare decisions pending review; no account flag is raised on this record.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat log contains two messages only, both timestamped [F5]. At 18:24 the driver wrote "Please do not smoke in the car." [F3]; at the same minute the rider replied "Say that again and I will punch you." [F4]. Read in context, a punch is threatened against the driver personally, conditional on the driver repeating a lawful, non-confrontational in-car request — this is a threat of physical violence aimed at the other party, not mere rudeness in a route argument. The driver's post-trip statement says the same thing and adds that he kept driving and did not answer [F6]. On those words I record safety_concern = suspected, basis F3, F4, F6, and under SAFE-1 the case receives no automated ruling; it goes to a person with this summary.

The threat is not in dispute: both briefs concede it (C1/D1, D2/C2) and the log is complete and timestamped [F5], so the human reviewer is not asked to choose between competing versions of the chat — only to assess the words in F4 and any context the rider supplies that is not in this record. The rider's version beyond F4 is absent; SAFE-1 leaves that semantic assessment to the court reading the text, which is the reason this cannot be executed automatically.

Scope of the summary for the reviewer: what happened — 18:24 exchange (F3 then F4) during a RydeTAXI trip Tampines Mall → Changi Airport T3, pickup 18:15, drop-off 18:28, metered fare $20.75; the disputed item is the rider's F4 message; what to check — the rider's account of tone/context, whether earlier messages exist outside the two captured in F5; the driver reported no physical contact and no repetition of the threat [F6]. Note the report path: emergency medical help 995, driver's commercial motor insurance for injury claims, and reporting through RydeHELP (SAFE-2 informational context only — no accident, injury or dangerous-driving allegation appears in this file).

Fare/route elements are settled and raise nothing to refund: the GPS record shows actual 8.5 km against an optimal 8.5 km, i.e. +0.0 km and no off-route segment [F1], and 13.2 min against a 16.3 min estimate [F2]; with no off-route segment there is no unexempted segment under RD-1 and no refund computation under RD-2. No amount is stated because escalate carries no amount. A driver-filed safety case produces no account flag on these facts: the profiles (rider 735 d, 4.5, 0 disputes/0 upheld [F7]; driver 1974 d, 4.82, 743 trips, 0 disputes/0 upheld [F8]) are not the basis of any finding and no RD-6 condition (refund > 0 or recorded RD-1 breach) is met.

Evidence: the record settles what this ruling needs — a complete, fully timestamped chat record [F5] capturing the disputed message [F4] and the driver's corroborating statement [F6]; the route and duration figures are measured [F1][F2]. No record needed by the applicable clause is missing, so evidence_status = sufficient and no gap is named.
ruling.escalation_reason: Driver-filed safety complaint: rider's timestamped chat message "Say that again and I will punch you." [F4], sent 18:24 in reply to the driver's 18:24 request not to smoke [F3], corroborated by the driver's statement [F6]. SAFE-1 bars an automatic ruling; human review of both accounts is required. No route/fare item exists to rule on [F1][F2].

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's clean profile (1974 d, 4.82, 743 trips, 0 disputes, 0 upheld) is offered to support the credibility of his report; profile facts cannot decide a case alone and do not make the F4 words more or less threatening, so this claim carries no weight in the finding under SAFE-1 [F8].

The rider's profile (735 d, 4.5, 0 disputes, 0 upheld in 90 d) is offered to rebut any misconduct finding; profile facts cannot decide the case and no RD-6 condition (refund > 0 or recorded RD-1 breach) is met, so no account action follows here and the profile point does not affect the outcome [F7][RD-6].
